sentences.text:
In Re: Sri Nikhil Majzmder alias
 Nikhil Majumdar & Anr.
 ....Petitioners.
 Mr. Indranuj Dutta,
 Mr. Atanu Basu,
 Ms. Benazir Sk,
 Mr. Asmanur Quail,
 .... For the Petitioners.
 1.

This is a application filed by the septuagenarian person being the father-in-law and the mother-in-law of the de facto complainant for quashing of the impugned proceeding being A.C.G.R Case No. 2157 of 2022 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 8th Court, Alipore, District- 24- Parganas (South) arising out of Kasba Police Station case no. 163 of 2022 dated 22nd May, 2022 under Section 498A/ 406/34 of the Indian Penal Code and read with Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act 1961.

2. It is submitted by the learned advocate representing the petitioners that omnibus allegations in the written complaint lodged by the de facto complainant on May 22, 2022 mostly attributed against the husband excepting certain frivolous allegations against the present petitioner.
Accordingly prays for quashing of the proceeding.

Perused the materials and contents of the written complaint which prima facie shows the allegations attributed against the husband, and certain allegations are also made against the present petitioner being the father-in-law.

4. However, the said complaint is now after completion of investigation has culminated into a charge-sheet and the date is fixed for framing of charge, appearance and in default warrant of arrest.
5.
In view of the above facts and circumstances, this Court finds that a prima facie case has been made out by the petitioners which is to be heard in presence of the opposite parties.

CRR/3718/2025 on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23971206/
1 6.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to serve copy of this revisional application along with all annexures to the opposite party no. 1/State through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no. 2 by Speed Post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.

7. Let the matter appear in the Combined Monthly List of November, 2025 before the regular Bench.
8.

Let there shall be stay of all further proceedings of A.C.G.R Case No. 2157 of 2022 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 8th Court, Alipore, District- 24-Parganas (South) for a period of four weeks after reopening of the court after ensuing Puja Vacation.

(Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.)
CRR/3718/2025 on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23971206/
